m1.typescript: m1 each documented http error maps to a type an origin and a recovery

e1.typescript: e1 a 429 is a rate limit or a spend cap and other statuses fall back by class

e2.typescript: e2 a successful response can still fail by its stop reason

e3.typescript: e3 an empty end turn is the integration when text followed the tool result and the model otherwise

e4.typescript: e4 a parse failure is the integration when a json object is in the text and the model when not

e5.typescript: e5 tool failures split into a model that called a missing tool and our tool that raised

e6.typescript: e6 the first failure names the cause and a later good response marks it recovered

e7.typescript: e7 a dropped connection has no status and belongs to the service side

wrong-retry-400.defect: retries a malformed request with back-off instead of fixing it

wrong-413-service.defect: blames the service for a request that is too large

wrong-429-always-retry.defect: treats a spend-cap 429 as an ordinary rate limit

wrong-spend-400-ignored.defect: treats a 400 spend-limit message as a malformed request

wrong-maxtokens-model.defect: blames the model for a response cut off by the caller's own max_tokens

wrong-refusal-retry.defect: retries a refusal with back-off instead of using a fallback model

wrong-empty-always-model.defect: blames the model for every empty end turn

wrong-empty-text-anywhere.defect: blames the integration whenever text and a tool result are both present, in any order

wrong-parse-always-model.defect: blames the model for every parse failure

wrong-parse-braces-only.defect: calls any text with braces a JSON object without parsing it

wrong-unknown-tool-integration.defect: blames the integration for a tool name the model invented

wrong-tool-error-flagged.defect: reports a tool result flagged is_error as a failure of our code

wrong-last-failure.defect: reports the last failure in the trace instead of the first

wrong-recovered-empty.defect: counts an empty end turn as a recovery

wrong-network-integration.defect: blames the integration for a dropped connection
